verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an optional AI plugin providing a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions for context-aware help, running commands, and explaining output (docs-15, gh-6). However, it's an opt-in add-on rather than a deeply integrated agent, and community evidence raises concerns about how cleanly it can be disabled/controlled (comm-2), and some users react negatively to its presence at all (comm-1). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the assistant's task-delegation capabilities, deeper documentation of its scope/limits, and confirmation the opt-in toggle behaves as expected.
